concerns.text: Tasks T215, T216, and T217 mandate experimental validation (Stark-effect spectroscopy) and external benchmarking. These directly contradict spec.md Assumptions and FR-011 which explicitly state 'Physical measurement validation is out of scope' and ground truth is QM9 DFT data. No spec FR/SC exists to support these tasks.

Tasks T222, T223, and T224 require conformational ensemble sampling (3-5 conformers). This violates spec.md Assumptions which state 'Single lowest-energy conformer per molecule... is used' and 'ensemble sampling is documented as future work'. No spec FR/SC supports this scope expansion.

Tasks T211, T212, and T213 introduce physics-informed regularization and specific bond-angle filters based on external reviews. These are not present in spec.md FR-004 (lightweight SchNet) or FR-007 (attribution). These tasks implement unrequested features not covered by any spec requirement.

Task T032 references an unresolved claim '[UNRESOLVED-CLAIM: c_9c69c6a0 — status=not_enough_info]'. While the task description covers FR-011, the unresolved claim status suggests the verification step for the QM9 reference data validation is incomplete or unverified in the current state.

Task T210 references an unresolved claim '[UNRESOLVED-CLAIM: c_375825be — status=not_enough_info]' regarding scope boundary documentation. This indicates a gap in the evidence that the required documentation (research.md) has been successfully updated as per the plan.
